result.summary: The page is largely intact, but there are a few minor visual/layout polish issues around horizontally scrolling content being clipped at the screen edge and some low-contrast secondary text.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off at the right edge after “Healthy,” with only a sliver of the next chip visible and no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add edge padding, fade/scroll indicator, or ensure the next chip peeks enough to communicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: In “Fastest near you,” the third card is partially clipped and the restaurant name appears truncated as “Trattoria Piccol…”, which can look broken even if the list is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Increase card peek width, add a scroll indicator, or shorten/truncate titles more deliberately with consistent ellipsis.

issues.description: Secondary metadata such as delivery fees and time/category text uses light gray on white/image backgrounds and may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Raise contrast of secondary text to meet WCAG AA, especially over imagery by adding scrims or darker text tokens.
